MY APPROACH

Building a robot.
Working through the details.

I learn by turning equations into hardware I can test. On my quadruped, that means working through the mechanism, electronics, and control code together.

These projects show my design decisions, the tests behind them, and the questions I’m still working on.

01 / SYSTEMS REASONING

Trace the problem.

When tracing a fault, I work through the mechanical interfaces, wiring, coordinate conventions, and control code.

02 / MEASURED ITERATION

Let tests guide the revision.

Bench tests helped me revise the output-shaft structure and gear-profile clearance in my cycloidal actuators.

03 / TECHNICAL COLLABORATION

Help teammates own the work.

I explain the interfaces, document test steps, and help teammates take responsibility for a subsystem.
